issue: The overnight worker evidence collector currently accepts impossible valid-action timing records: an action can be reported ready before the complete response, or a malformed action can carry a readiness time. In worker/collect_overnight.py, enforce a boolean action-format result for completed replies. For a valid action require a finite nonnegative readiness time at or after response completion; for an invalid action forbid a readiness field. Keep valid boundary times accepted and preserve the existing token-arrival and throughput consistency checks. Add focused offline acceptance/regression coverage; do not change recorded campaign evidence or loosen other integrity checks.
